milestone: Earliest documented military rockets (Jin 'fire arrows', siege of Kaifeng)
significance: Earliest documentary reports of rocket weapons; device details disputed by historians. (The Wan Hu flight story is legend and is excluded.)

milestone: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation published
significance: Derived the math of rocket propulsion — the theoretical basis for all spaceflight

milestone: Goddard's first liquid-fuel rocket
significance: First flight of a liquid-propellant rocket (2.5 s, 12.5 m) — Auburn, Massachusetts

milestone: GIRD-09 — first Soviet liquid-propellant rocket
significance: GIRD (Tsander, Korolev, Tikhonravov) launch; start of the Soviet rocket lineage

milestone: V-2 (A-4) reaches space
significance: First human-made object to cross the ~100 km Kármán line (a test flight); basis of postwar US & Soviet programs

milestone: First Soviet A-4 (V-2) launches, Kapustin Yar
significance: Launch experience fed directly into the R-1 and later R-7

milestone: Bumper 5 — first two-stage liquid rocket to space (393 km)
significance: Demonstrated staging, a prerequisite for orbital flight

milestone: Dezik & Tsygan — first dogs to fly to space and return
significance: Suborbital flight from Kapustin Yar; recovered alive

milestone: R-7 Semyorka first successful flight
significance: World's first ICBM; the launcher lineage that still flies as Soyuz today

milestone: Sputnik 1 — first artificial satellite
significance: Opened the space age; 83 kg, beeped for 3 weeks

milestone: Sputnik 2 — first animal in orbit (Laika)
significance: First living creature to orbit Earth

milestone: Explorer 1 — first US satellite
significance: First US satellite; discovered the Van Allen radiation belts

milestone: Luna 1 — first Earth-escape / lunar flyby
significance: First craft to leave Earth's gravity and fly past the Moon

milestone: Luna 2 — first craft to reach the Moon
significance: First human-made object to impact another celestial body

milestone: Luna 3 — first images of the lunar far side
significance: First photos of the Moon's hidden hemisphere

milestone: T-7M — first Chinese sounding rocket flight
significance: Launched from Nanhui, Shanghai after a failed first attempt in January 1960

milestone: Vostok 1 — Gagarin, first human in space
significance: First human in space: one orbit of Earth (~327 km, 108 min)

milestone: Freedom 7 — Alan Shepard, first American in space
significance: First American in space, a 15-minute suborbital flight three weeks after Gagarin.

milestone: Friendship 7 — John Glenn, first American to orbit Earth
significance: First American to complete an orbit of Earth (three orbits).

milestone: Mariner 2 — first successful planetary flyby
significance: First spacecraft to successfully fly by another planet (Venus).

milestone: Vostok 6 — Tereshkova, first woman in space
significance: First woman to fly in space, solo, 48 orbits

milestone: Voskhod 2 — Leonov, first spacewalk
significance: First extravehicular activity (~12 min)

milestone: Luna 9 — first soft landing on the Moon
significance: First soft landing on another world; returned surface images

milestone: Apollo 8 — first humans to the Moon's vicinity
significance: First crewed flight to leave Earth orbit and circle the Moon

milestone: Apollo 11 — first crewed lunar landing
significance: First humans to walk on another world

milestone: Dong Fang Hong 1 — first Chinese satellite
significance: China becomes the 5th nation to orbit a satellite

milestone: Lunokhod 1 — first roving vehicle on another world
significance: First wheeled rover to operate on the Moon

milestone: Venera 7 — first soft landing on another planet
significance: First data returned from the surface of another planet (Venus)

milestone: Salyut 1 — first space station
significance: First crewed space station in orbit

milestone: Mariner 9 — first spacecraft to orbit another planet
significance: First spacecraft to enter orbit around another planet (Mars).

milestone: Pioneer 10 — first Jupiter flyby & first through the asteroid belt
significance: First craft to traverse the asteroid belt and fly by Jupiter.

milestone: Viking 1 — first successful Mars landing
significance: First long-lived lander on Mars

milestone: Ariane 1 — first ESA orbital launch
significance: First launch of Europe's independent access to orbit.

milestone: Space Shuttle STS-1 — first reusable crewed spacecraft
significance: First reusable orbiter (partial reuse)

milestone: Mir — first modular space station
significance: First long-duration modular station; basis for ISS partnership

milestone: Hubble Space Telescope — first of NASA's Great Observatories
significance: First large optical/UV space telescope; redefined observational astronomy.

milestone: ISS Expedition 1 — first permanent crew aboard the ISS
significance: Start of continuous human presence in orbit aboard the International Space Station.

milestone: Shenzhou 5 — Yang Liwei, first Chinese human spaceflight
significance: China becomes the 3rd nation to independently launch a human

milestone: Huygens — first landing in the outer solar system
significance: First soft landing on a body in the outer solar system (Titan).

milestone: Chang'e 1 — first Chinese lunar orbiter
significance: China's first mission to the Moon

milestone: Falcon 1 — first privately developed liquid-fuel rocket to orbit
significance: First privately funded, liquid-fueled launch vehicle to reach orbit.

milestone: Hayabusa — first asteroid sample return
significance: First mission to return a sample from an asteroid (Itokawa) to Earth.

milestone: Dragon (COTS Demo) — first commercial spacecraft to the ISS
significance: First privately built spacecraft to berth with the International Space Station.

milestone: Voyager 1 — first spacecraft to reach interstellar space
significance: Launched 1977; crossed into interstellar space in 2012, the most distant human-made object.

milestone: Chang'e 3 / Yutu — first Chinese soft landing on Moon
significance: First Chinese soft landing and rover on the Moon

milestone: Mars Orbiter Mission (Mangalyaan) — Mars orbit on the first attempt
significance: First nation to reach Mars orbit on its debut interplanetary attempt.

milestone: Rosetta / Philae — first soft landing on a comet
significance: First controlled landing on a comet nucleus (67P).

milestone: New Horizons — first Pluto flyby
significance: First and only close flyby of Pluto to date.

milestone: Falcon 9 — first orbital-class booster landing (first reflight 30 Mar 2017)
significance: First vertical landing of an orbital-class first stage (Dec 2015); first reflight in 2017 — the reusability breakthrough.

milestone: Chang'e 4 — first landing on the lunar far side
significance: World first: soft landing on the Moon's far side (Von Kármán crater)

milestone: Crew Dragon Demo-2 — first crewed orbital flight by a private company
significance: First orbital human spaceflight operated by a commercial provider.

milestone: Chang'e 5 — Chinese lunar sample return
significance: First lunar samples returned since 1976

milestone: Ingenuity — first powered flight on another planet
significance: First powered, controlled flight in another planet's atmosphere (Mars).

milestone: Tianwen-1 / Zhurong — first Chinese Mars landing
significance: China becomes the 2nd nation to operate a rover on Mars

milestone: James Webb Space Telescope — largest space telescope launched (6.5 m)
significance: Largest, most powerful space telescope ever launched (NASA/ESA/CSA).

milestone: Tiangong — Chinese modular space station complete
significance: China's permanently crewed modular station fully assembled

milestone: Chandrayaan-3 — first soft landing near the lunar south pole
significance: First soft landing in the lunar south-polar region.

milestone: Artemis II — first crewed flight beyond LEO since 1972; farthest humans from Earth
significance: Crewed lunar flyby, 1-11 Apr 2026 (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen); passed Apollo 13's distance record

milestone: Long March 10B — first Chinese recovery of an orbital-class booster
significance: China became the second nation to recover an orbital-class booster, and the first to do so with a net-capture system at sea.

milestone: Isar Spectrum — first rocket to reach orbit from Western Europe
significance: Launched from Andøya, Norway, after the maiden flight failed in Mar 2025

milestone: Starship Flight 14 — first orbital Starship flight (26 Starlink V3)
significance: First orbital and first commercial flight of a fully reusable-design super-heavy launcher
